request: Animate all charts where possible: at least the last 8 periods (Q, H or A) and projections to end-2030.

definitions.animation: timeline (marks animate through periods) | step through years (cross-section redrawn per period) | model scrub (projection model) | none
definitions.ge8_periods: true when ≥8 periods of the frequency used are held now; "n/a" for KPI/diagram/model
definitions.category: ready_now = animatable with ≥8 periods held; needs_history = animatable but <8 periods held; no_animation = diagram/table/KPI or structurally <8
definitions.projection_status: exists_to_2030 | partial (some years, targets only or average bands) | to_add (credible source exists, not yet in data) | model_only (dashboard model/scenario only) | none_history_only | n/a
definitions.effort: S ≤ half a day, data held, mostly Ed wiring; M = owner agent collects ≤ ~10 points or adds projection rows + wiring; L = multi-period cross-section or methodology work
